title: Italy
lead: Europe's oldest universities, hundreds of English-taught programmes and a scholarship based on family income.

blocks.title: Main reasons
items: The University of Bologna was founded in 1088: the oldest university in Europe.
In the QS 2027 ranking Politecnico di Milano is #87, Sapienza #111, Bologna #123.
You can study in English: in 2025/26 there were 742 fully English-taught and 420 bilingual programmes.
Low tuition fees: for example, in Pisa foreign students pay 290–2 900 € a year, in Messina 156–506 €.
Scholarship: the DSU is based on family income. A student with a scholarship is exempt from tuition fees.
The degree is recognised in Europe.

items.text: A 1-year preparatory course. It may be needed to enter a bachelor's with an 11-year school certificate. Price, depending on the university, 1 300–5 000 €.

items.title: Bachelor's (Laurea)
items.text: 3 years, 180 ECTS. Usually requires 12 years of schooling or 11 years + Foundation / 1 year of university.

items.title: Master's (Laurea Magistrale)
items.text: 2 years, 120 ECTS. Bachelor's degree, English B2, often a CV and motivation letter.

items.title: Single cycle
items.text: Fields such as medicine, dentistry and architecture last 5–6 years and admit students through a separate test (for example IMAT).

blocks.text: Tests depend on the programme: CEnT-S, TOLC, SAT, IMAT or an interview. It is stated precisely in each programme's call (bando).

blocks.title: How the scholarship (DSU) works
blocks.body:
In each region the scholarship is given by its own agency: DiSCo in Lazio, EDISU in Piedmont, ER.GO in Emilia-Romagna, DSU Toscana in Tuscany. In Lombardy each university gives it itself.

The scholarship is based on family income and assets. For this, documents on family composition, income and housing from Uzbekistan are legalised at the Italian Embassy or apostilled and brought with an Italian translation; in Italy a CAF calculates the ISEE parificato from them.

In 2026/27 the maximum amount for a fuori sede student was about 7 171–8 248 € (more for women in STEM in some regions). In some cities the dormitory and meals are free, in others they are paid out of the scholarship.

blocks.title: Main tasks after arrival
items: Within 8 days, the permesso di soggiorno application: via the kit at the post office, then the Questura.
Codice fiscale: tax code. Needed for the bank, SIM card and rental contract.
Health insurance: private or voluntary registration with the SSN.
Full enrollment at the university: with original documents.

blocks.title: Rules
items: Work: 20 hours a week, up to 1 040 hours a year (DPR 394/1999, article 14).
With a permesso you can travel to other Schengen countries for up to 90 days within 180 days.
After graduating, if the conditions are met, you can get a job-seeking permit for up to 12 months.

blocks.text: You cannot enrol at a university on a tourist visa. Only a type D student visa.
